scope: One synthetic local-model task sequence, repeated after a context-fit fix, plus one final-code agency check in the same corrected RAM world. Not a statistical benchmark or a test establishing consciousness.

method.roles: The same installed model served four separate functional calls.
method.execution: Runtime source loaded into RAM from GitHub. Actual engine/contracts/store/inference; scripted demo disabled. Simulator actions were selected by the real model.
method.storage: No model/package downloads or local project/test/database artifact files were created.
method.timing: Wall-clock cycle timing. No forced model unload, controlled cold/warm comparison, or competing-load benchmark was performed.
method.faculty_capture: Initial/corrected role_calls contain selected structured output fields; strings capped at 800 characters and list entries at 240 characters. Final guard role_calls retain full structured result objects. No model thinking-channel content was collected.

final_guard.reload: Only core/inference.py differed among the nine loaded runtime files. It was reloaded and a new Ollama client attached to the same engine and open RAM store before another ordinary user turn. The simulator actions were not replayed.

assessment.initial: Two real simulator actions succeeded. The follow-up agency turn failed before Buddhi generation because its context exceeded the configured budget; there was no outward agency reply.
assessment.corrected: Both real simulator actions and the ordinary agency turn completed. Public observation and evaluator state agreed that the key was carried. The two-action budget stopped autonomy.
assessment.final_guard: All four roles completed on final runtime code. The reply correctly identified moving forward and picking up the key and denied actions outside the simulation. No further actions occurred and the world state was unchanged.
assessment.limits: These observations establish behavior in this short task. They do not establish subjective experience, general reliability, broader intelligence gains, physical robot competence, or long-term learning.
